items.headline: Nikola Jokic Reaches 200th Career Triple-Double!
items.summary: Denver Nuggets superstar Nikola Jokic recorded his 200th career regular-season triple-double last night, tallying 21 points, 13 rebounds, and 10 assists in a 104-91 victory over the New Orleans Pelicans. This historic achievement further solidifies his place among the league's all-time greats.

items.headline: Houston Rockets Remain Undefeated at 5-0
items.summary: The Houston Rockets continued their dominant start to the season, improving to a perfect 5-0 with a decisive 132-100 win against the Milwaukee Bucks. Fred VanVleet led the charge with 24 points, while Amen Thompson added 23, showcasing the Rockets' early-season prowess.

items.headline: Heat Secure First Win Behind Antetokounmpo's Double-Double
items.summary: The Miami Heat earned their first victory of the season, defeating the Atlanta Hawks 129-117. Giannis Antetokounmpo contributed 24 points and 18 rebounds, alongside Bam Adebayo's 24 points.

items.headline: Wemby Drops 36 as Spurs Win Third Straight
items.summary: Victor Wembanyama exploded for 36 points and 14 rebounds, leading the San Antonio Spurs to their third consecutive win with a 117-111 triumph over the Utah Jazz.

items.headline: Rockets Stay Perfect, Crush Bucks
items.summary: The Houston Rockets extended their undefeated streak to 5-0, dominating the Milwaukee Bucks 132-100. Fred VanVleet had 24 points and Amen Thompson added 23 for Houston.

items.headline: Maxey's Fourth-Quarter Surge Lifts Sixers Over Pacers
items.summary: Tyrese Maxey scored 27 points, including 17 in the final quarter, to lead the Philadelphia 76ers to a 114-109 road victory over the Indiana Pacers. Joel Embiid added 21 points and 11 rebounds.

items.headline: Cavaliers Beat Wizards as Dybantsa Debuts
items.summary: The Cleveland Cavaliers defeated the Washington Wizards 121-111. Evan Mobley scored 24 points with a career-high five 3-pointers, while rookie AJ Dybantsa had 19 points in his NBA debut for the Wizards.

items.headline: Cunningham's 30 Points Power Pistons Past Hornets
items.summary: Cade Cunningham's 30-point performance propelled the Detroit Pistons to a 97-89 victory over the Charlotte Hornets, who saw Brandon Miller contribute 31 points and 12 rebounds.

items.headline: Brunson's Big Night Leads Knicks Over Bulls
items.summary: Jalen Brunson's 38 points and 7 assists guided the New York Knicks to a 133-127 win against the Chicago Bulls.

items.headline: Jokic Triple-Double Secures Nuggets Win
items.summary: Nikola Jokic posted his 200th career triple-double with 21 points, 13 rebounds, and 10 assists as the Denver Nuggets beat the winless New Orleans Pelicans 104-91.

items.headline: Lakers Cruise Past Clippers in Intra-City Battle
items.summary: Despite Luka Doncic's absence, the Los Angeles Lakers secured a 103-87 victory over the LA Clippers. Quentin Grimes led the Lakers with 23 points.

items.headline: Mavericks Hand Thunder First Loss
items.summary: The Dallas Mavericks handed the Oklahoma City Thunder their first loss of the season, dominating them 120-96.

items.headline: Curry's 44 Points Lead Warriors Over Timberwolves
items.summary: Stephen Curry exploded for 44 points, leading the Golden State Warriors to a 119-114 victory against the Minnesota Timberwolves. Yaxel Lendeborg added 26 points for the Warriors.

items.headline: Tyrese Haliburton Sidelined for Pacers
items.summary: Indiana Pacers star Tyrese Haliburton is expected to miss approximately two weeks due to a hamstring injury, a significant blow to the Pacers' early-season aspirations.

items.headline: Luka Doncic Out with Back Tightness
items.summary: Dallas Mavericks guard Luka Doncic sat out Wednesday's game against the Clippers due to back tightness on the second night of a back-to-back.

items.headline: Magic Hit with Key Injuries
items.summary: The Orlando Magic will be without Paolo Banchero for six weeks and Jalen Suggs for two weeks due to injuries, impacting their roster depth.

items.headline: Thunder Dealing with Multiple Injuries
items.summary: The Oklahoma City Thunder are facing a wave of injuries, with a key player (likely Jalen Williams) out for an extended period with a dislocated ankle and Cason Wallace sidelined with a torn labrum.

items.headline: NBA Cup Tournament Kicks Off Tomorrow
items.summary: The fourth edition of the in-season NBA Cup tournament is set to begin tomorrow, October 30, 2026, running through December 11. Teams have been grouped for the highly anticipated competition.

items.headline: Thursday's NBA Slate: Cavs-Hawks, Kings-Pels, Grizzlies-Blazers
items.summary: Three NBA games are scheduled for Thursday, October 29, including the Cleveland Cavaliers facing the Atlanta Hawks, the Sacramento Kings visiting the New Orleans Pelicans, and the Memphis Grizzlies taking on the Portland Trail Blazers.
